source: NeoKid Care Phase 7 — CBC/urine/TSH mini-panels. WBC bands: URMC Health Encyclopedia + Seattle Children's lab ranges. Platelets 150–450 (ABPath pediatric CBC). TSH: Mayo Clinic Labs pediatric s-TSH. Urine: dipstick reading guide (flag ≥1+). Screening flags only — confirm against the reporting lab's own ranges.
verification: PENDING — every threshold needs clinician verification before real-world use

notes.protein: Protein ≥1+ — repeat clean-catch + quantify (UPCR); persistent proteinuria needs renal workup.
notes.leuco: Leucocytes + nitrite together suggest UTI — send culture before antibiotics.
notes.nitrite: Nitrite positive — bacterial conversion; correlate with leucocytes + symptoms, send culture.
notes.blood: Haematuria — exclude UTI, stones, GN (check BP + protein + creatinine); refer if persistent.
notes.glucose: Glycosuria — check blood glucose + HbA1c; new finding needs same-day review.
notes.ketones: Ketonuria — if diabetic/ill, check glucose + gases; DKA risk. If starvation, rehydrate + retest.

tshNeo.unit: mIU/L, SERUM units (serum TSH ~= 2.2x whole-blood DBS; convert before interpreting)
tshNeo.source: Table II age-specific TSH reference, Behura et al, Indian Pediatr 2023;60:855-856 (term day-points + preterm GA 95th-percentile uppers); action cutoffs ISPAE-2018 vs AAP-2023, same article Table I. Preterm printed ranges used at their UPPER end (11.8 / 9) to minimise false positives.
